CSE-5151                                                                                                                about:srcdoc  
  
  
  Exam Date & Time: 30-Nov-2024 (02:30 PM - 05:30 PM)  
  
  
  MANIPAL ACADEMY OF HIGHER EDUCATION  
  MIT BLR - BTech V Semester - End Semester Examination - Nov / Dec -2024  
  ADVANCED COMPUTER NETWORKS [CSE-5151]  
  Marks: 50                                                                               Duration: 180 mins.  
  PART-A  
  Answer all the questions.  
  1)           Compare and contrast MANET, VANET and UAV networks.  
  (4)  
  A)  
  B)      Explain UAV routing protocols in detail.                                                  (4)  
  C)      Illustrate the limitations of UAVs.                                                       (2)  
  2)           Explain with neat diagram the architecture of SDN.  
  (4)  
  A)  
  B)      Explain application network policy defining workload connectivity and security service  
  policies.                                                                              (4)  
  
  C)      With suitable example explain the network virtualization components.                      (2)  
  3)           Discuss the benefits of Overlay Networks that can help meet the challenges of the  
  modern data canter.  
  (4)  
  A)  
  B)      Explain the components of OpenFlow network architecture.                                  (4)  
  C)      Explain the access control for two locations, each with a data canter and front office  
  where all routers exchange routes over all links.                                         (2)  
  
  4)           Explain the client-side buffering playout with suitable example.  
  (4)  
  A)  
  B)      Determine how the packet loss can be recovered in VoIP focusing on various recovery  
  mechanisms.                                                                               (4)  
  
  C)      Show how to mitigate the problem of "what if applications misbehave (VoIP sends  
  higher than declared rate)" in VoIP network.                                              (2)

  $$attenuation loss and amplification for the given values (Pt)dBW = 10 log(Pt)W and$$  
  (4)  
  $$(Pt)dBm = 10 log(Pt)mW.$$  
  A)  
  B)         Interpret the wavelength-routing mesh network for OLTs, OADMs and OXCs.              (4)  
  C)         Explain how the multiple signals to be transmitted simultaneously using WDM.         (2)  
  
  -----End-----
